title: Equal Groups: Joining and Sharing
seo_title: Grade 2 Equal Groups Worksheets: Arrays and Sharing (TEKS 2.6A, 2.6B)
standard_text: 2.6A model, create, and describe contextual multiplication situations in which equivalent sets of concrete objects are joined; 2.6B model, create, and describe contextual division situations in which a set of concrete objects is separated into equivalent sets
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 worksheets for Texas TEKS 2.6A and 2.6B: equal groups, arrays, adding rows and columns, sharing equally and stories. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Equal groups have the same number in each.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Equal groups have the same number in each group.
  • Joining equal groups: 3 groups of 4 is 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.
  • An array puts objects in equal rows and columns.
  • Sharing splits a total into equal groups: 12 shared by 3 is 4 each.

Examples

Example

4 rows of 5 chairs

5 + 5 + 5 + 5

Answer: 20 chairs

Example

15 cookies shared by 3

3 groups of 5

Answer: 5 each

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting rows instead of objectsCount every object, or add the rows.
Adding the groups and the size3 groups of 4 is 12, not 7.
Sharing unequallyEach group must have the same number.

Objects in equal rows and equal columns.
Add the groups back together to get the total.

items.e: Rows go across. Count them from top to bottom: there are 3 rows. Each row has 5 dots, but 5 is the number of columns.
Rows go across. Count them from top to bottom: there are 2 rows. Each row has 4 stars, but 4 is the number of columns.

items.q: How many rows are in this array?
items.e: Rows go across. Count them from top to bottom: there are 4 rows. Each row has 3 squares, but 3 is the number of columns.

items.q: How many rows are in this array?
items.e: Rows go across. Count them from top to bottom: there are 5 rows. Each row has 2 dots, but 2 is the number of columns.
Columns go up and down. Count them from left to right: there are 5 columns. 2 is the number of rows.

items.q: How many columns are in this array?
items.e: Columns go up and down. Count them from left to right: there are 2 columns. 4 is the number of rows.

items.q: How many columns are in this array?
items.e: Columns go up and down. Count them from left to right: there are 4 columns. 3 is the number of rows.
Columns go up and down. Count them from left to right: there are 3 columns. 5 is the number of rows.

items.q: How many squares are in each row?
items.e: Look at one row, across. It has 5 squares. Every row has the same number.

items.q: How many dots are in each row?
items.e: Look at one row, across. It has 3 dots. Every row has the same number.
Look at one row, across. It has 2 stars. Every row has the same number.

items.q: How many squares are in each column?
items.e: Look at one column, up and down. It has 5 squares. Every column has the same number.

items.q: How many dots are in each column?
items.e: Look at one column, up and down. It has 3 dots. Every column has the same number.
Look at one column, up and down. It has 4 stars. Every column has the same number.

items.q: Which words tell about this array?
items.e: Count across for rows: 2. Count up and down for columns: 3. So it is 2 rows, 3 columns.
Count across for rows: 4. Count up and down for columns: 5. So it is 4 rows, 5 columns.
Count across for rows: 5. Count up and down for columns: 3. So it is 5 rows, 3 columns.

items.q: An array has 4 rows. Each row has 5 dots. How many columns does it have?
items.e: Each row has 5 dots, so there are 5 dots across. That makes 5 columns.

items.q: An array has 3 columns. Each column has 2 stars. How many rows does it have?
items.e: Each column has 2 stars, so there are 2 stars from top to bottom. That makes 2 rows.

items.q: In an array, which way does a row go?
items.e: A row goes across, like the words in a line of a book. A column goes up and down.

items.q: Which addition adds the rows?
items.e: There are 3 rows. Each row has 4. So add 4, 3 times: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.
There are 2 rows. Each row has 5. So add 5, 2 times: 5 + 5 = 10.

items.q: Which addition adds the rows?
items.e: There are 4 rows. Each row has 3. So add 3, 4 times: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12.

items.q: Which addition adds the rows?
items.e: There are 5 rows. Each row has 2. So add 2, 5 times: 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 10.
There are 3 rows. Each row has 5. So add 5, 3 times: 5 + 5 + 5 = 15.

items.q: Which addition adds the rows?
items.e: There are 4 rows. Each row has 4. So add 4, 4 times: 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16.

items.q: Add the rows. 3 + 3 = ?
items.e: Add one row at a time: 3, 6. The total is 6.
Add one row at a time: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15. The total is 15.
Add one row at a time: 3, 6, 9. The total is 9.
Add one row at a time: 5, 10, 15, 20. The total is 20.

items.q: Add the rows. 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = ?
items.e: Add one row at a time: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25. The total is 25.

items.q: Which addition shows 3 rows of 5 dots?
items.e: 3 rows of 5 means 3 rows with 5 in each row. Add 5, 3 times: 5 + 5 + 5.

items.q: Which addition shows 2 rows of 4 stars?
items.e: 2 rows of 4 means 2 rows with 4 in each row. Add 4, 2 times: 4 + 4.

items.q: Which addition shows 5 rows of 4 squares?
items.e: 5 rows of 4 means 5 rows with 4 in each row. Add 4, 5 times: 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4.
Count on by 3: 3, 6, 9, 12. So the total is 12.
Count on by 5: 5, 10, 15. So the total is 15.
Count on by 2: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. So the total is 10.
In repeated addition, every addend is the same. 4 + 4 = 8, and 8 + 4 = 12. The missing number is 4.
In repeated addition, every addend is the same. 5 + 5 + 5 = 15, and 15 + 5 = 20. The missing number is 5.
In repeated addition, every addend is the same. 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12, and 12 + 3 = 15. The missing number is 3.

sets.title: Add the columns and match arrays

items.e: There are 4 columns. Each column has 3. So add 3, 4 times: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12.

items.q: Which addition adds the columns?
items.e: There are 5 columns. Each column has 2. So add 2, 5 times: 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 10.

items.q: Which addition adds the columns?
items.e: There are 3 columns. Each column has 4. So add 4, 3 times: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.

items.q: Which addition adds the columns?
items.e: There are 3 columns. Each column has 2. So add 2, 3 times: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6.
There are 4 columns. Each column has 5. So add 5, 4 times: 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 20.

items.q: Add the columns. 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = ?
items.e: Add one column at a time: 2, 4, 6, 8. The total is 8.

items.q: Add the columns. 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = ?
items.e: Add one column at a time: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15. The total is 15.
Add one column at a time: 4, 8. The total is 8.

items.q: Add the columns. 5 + 5 + 5 = ?
items.e: Add one column at a time: 5, 10, 15. The total is 15.

items.q: The rows add up: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12. What do the columns add up to?
items.e: It is the same array, so it has the same squares. The columns are 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12. Rows or columns, the total does not change.

items.q: Which equation matches this array?
items.e: There are 3 rows of 4. Add the rows: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.

items.q: Which equation matches this array?
items.e: There are 2 rows of 5. Add the rows: 5 + 5 = 10.
There are 4 rows of 2. Add the rows: 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8.
There are 5 rows of 3. Add the rows: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 15.

items.q: Which equation matches this array?
items.e: There are 3 rows of 3. Add the rows: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.
4 + 4 + 4 means 3 rows with 4 in each row. A has 3 rows of 4. The others have 2 rows of 4, 4 rows of 4, 3 rows of 3.
5 + 5 means 2 rows with 5 in each row. A has 2 rows of 5. The others have 1 row of 5, 3 rows of 5, 2 rows of 4.

items.q: Which array shows 3 + 3 + 3 + 3?
items.e: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 means 4 rows with 3 in each row. D has 4 rows of 3. The others have 3 rows of 3, 5 rows of 3, 4 rows of 2.
2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 means 5 rows with 2 in each row. C has 5 rows of 2. The others have 4 rows of 2, 5 rows of 1, 5 rows of 3.

items.q: Which array shows 5 + 5 + 5?
items.e: 5 + 5 + 5 means 3 rows with 5 in each row. B has 3 rows of 5. The others have 2 rows of 5, 4 rows of 5, 3 rows of 4.

items.q: An egg carton has 2 rows of eggs. Each row has 5 eggs. How many eggs are in the carton?
items.e: 2 rows of 5 is an array. Add the rows: 5 + 5 = 10 eggs.

items.q: Lucia puts chairs in 4 rows. Each row has 3 chairs. How many chairs are there in all?

items.q: A muffin pan has 3 rows. Each row has 4 cups. How many muffins can it bake at one time?

items.q: Sofia wants to draw 4 rows of 3 dots. What is wrong with her drawing?

items.q: Camila wants to draw 3 rows of 5 dots. What is wrong with her drawing?
items.e: There are 3 rows with 5 dots in each row. Nothing is wrong. It is 5 + 5 + 5 = 15.
